blocks.head: alt The user is away from the device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user is near the device
alt The user has key and the device exists
alt The user has a key

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : false , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' Device 
= < UserX | ('near' : true , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : true , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' Device 
= < UserX | ('near' : false , ..) > .

eq < Device | ('owner' : nils , 'online' : false , 'key' : Key , .. , 'buttonPressed' : true) > $ UserX 'pressButton' Device 
= < Device | ('owner' : nils , 'online' : true , 'key' : Key , 'buttonPressed' : true , ..) > $ Device 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) .

eq < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > $ Device 'sendKey' UserX | (Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < Device | ('owner' : nils , 'online' : true , 'key' : Key , ...) > < Cloud | (Device : ('owner' : nils , 'key' : Key , ....) , .....) > $ UserX 'bind' Cloud | (Device ; Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < Device | ('owner' : UserX , 'online' : true , 'key' : Key , ...) > < Cloud | (Device : ('owner' : UserX , 'key' : Key , ....) , .....) > .

eq < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < Cloud | (Device : ('owner' : UserX , 'key' : CloudKey , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'reset' Cloud | (Device ; Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < Cloud | (Device : ('owner' : nils , 'key' : CloudKey , ...) , ....) > $ Cloud 'resetDevice' Device .

eq < Device | ('online' : true , 'owner' : UserX , ..) > $ Cloud 'resetDevice' Device 
= < Device | ('online' : false , 'owner' : nils , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : false , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX, deviceB) @ S < UserX | ('near' : false , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : true , ..) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, deviceB) @ S < UserX | ('near' : true , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : true , ..) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX, deviceB) @ S < UserX | ('near' : true , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev4
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev4]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > 
=> ep: ev4(UserX, cloudB, deviceB, Key) @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > .

event_rules.label: rev5
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev5]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > 
=> ep: ev5(UserX, cloudB, deviceB, Key) @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .
